applicableAreas: Buildings (8 structures) near overhead electric utilities on property boundaries
findings.comment: Overhead electric utilities are confirmed on property boundaries (Sheet 4). Proposed buildings shown on site plan. Whether buildings maintain minimum 7.5-foot sky-to-ground clearance from overhead conductors cannot be determined without surveyed conductor elevations and clearance dimensions, which are not provided.

applicableAreas: Buildings with potential overhangs, awnings, balconies, or rooflines near overhead utilities
findings.comment: Overhead utilities confirmed on site. Section views and building elevations showing clearances from building projections (overhangs, awnings, balconies) to surveyed overhead conductors are not provided. Both 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances cannot be verified without these exhibits.

Site plan set does not include building elevation sheets. Surveyed elevations and locations of overhead electric conductors are required to be shown on building elevation sheets per UCM § 1.10.3, but such sheets are not provided in the site plan.

applicableAreas: All proposed buildings and building projections
findings.comment: Section views and enlarged plan detail exhibits are not provided. Code requires dimension lines showing clearances from outer electric conductor to outermost edges of buildings and building projections. No such exhibits are present in the site plan set.

applicableAreas: Internal driveways and site circulation areas
findings.comment: Driveways are shown on grading plan. Overhead utilities confirmed on property boundaries. Whether driveways maintain minimum 16-foot (parking without trucks) or 18-foot (areas with truck traffic) vertical clearance from overhead lines cannot be verified. No surveyed mid-span clearance dimensions from overhead conductors to finished driveway grades are provided.

applicableAreas: All clearance dimensions shown on site plans near overhead utilities
findings.comment: Where clearance dimensions appear on plans, whether they are measured from the outside conductor location (not pole centerline) cannot be verified from available evidence. On multi-conductor installations, outer conductor position may be several feet offset from pole center, making this distinction critical for accurate clearance verification.

applicableAreas: Site features near overhead electric lines (buildings, driveways, parking areas)
findings.comment: Overhead electric utilities exist on property boundaries. Proposed site features appear positioned near these utilities. Registered surveyor survey data showing pole locations and mid-span clearance measurements is required but not provided. Vertical clearance compliance cannot be demonstrated without this surveyor data.

applicableAreas: Landscape areas along southern and western property boundaries where overhead electric utilities exist
findings.comment: Landscape plan (Sheet 31) shows trees within 10 feet of overhead electric lines marked as mitigation (M) and street yard (SY) trees without species identification on the plan. Plant schedule (Sheet 35) lists Cedar Elm (not utility-compatible), Live Oak (not utility-compatible), Mexican Redbud (utility-compatible), and Texas Mountain Laurel (utility-compatible), but does not spatially correlate which species are planted in areas within 10 lateral feet of distribution conductors. Tree species compliance for those within clearance distances cannot be verified.
